Gloves that call up ghostly hands to tickle
a foe helpless. Sacred.

585.name: Arm Bracers
585.description:
Metal bands worn on the forearms to block
and strike.

586.name: Iron Knuckles
586.description:
Fighting gloves plated over the knuckles.
Can stun on hit.

587.name: Kendo Mask
587.description:
A steel kendo mask, swung by the cords.
Can stun on hit.

588.name: Flying Kicks
588.description:
Training that puts a body's whole weight
behind a kick.

589.name: Adamantine Fists
589.description: Heavy steel gauntlets faced with adamantine.

590.name: Shock Gauntlets
590.description:
Gauntlets that throw a shock on impact.
Thunder, inflicts Static.

591.name: Mithril Strike Gloves
591.description:
Light gloves faced with mithril.
Can stun on hit.

592.name: Sonic Gauntlet
592.description:
A gauntlet that throws a sonic shockwave.
Can stun on hit.

593.name: Thunder Lizard Gauntlets
593.description:
Gauntlets scaled from an old thunder lizard.
Strikes with Thunder.

594.name: Lightning Elemental Fists
594.description:
Gauntlets drawn from a lightning elemental.
Thunder, inflicts Static.

595.name: Force Crush Gloves
595.description:
Gloves set with crystals that crush a foe
from inside. Thunder, can static.

596.name: Nightmare Gauntlets
596.description:
Gauntlets set from hardened nightmare.
They frighten on contact.

597.name: Arcane Shield Gauntlets
597.description:
Gauntlets that raise shields against blade
and spell alike. Water.

598.name: Metamorphic Gauntlets
598.description:
Gauntlets that fold into other weapons
at will.

599.name: Master's Gauntlets
599.description:
Old gauntlets said to be a great martial
artist's.

600.name: Telekinetic Gauntlets
600.description:
Gauntlets that amplify telekinesis and
strike at a distance.

601.name: Fox Spirit Fists
601.description:
Stone gauntlets cut with the Gobekli Tepe
foxes. They lend speed. Cursed.

602.name: Mind Manipulator Gloves
602.description:
Gloves that reach into a mind and take
or change what is there.

603.name: EHI Petrochem Injectors
603.description:
Gauntlets that inject oil-based enhancers.
Great strength, ruined organs.

604.name: Phasing Touch
604.description:
Gobekli Tepe gauntlets that pass through
matter. Ice.

605.name: Varlenia Fist
605.description:
Golden Varlenia gauntlets that put arcane
force behind a punch. Thunder.

606.name: Molecular Manipulator Gloves
606.description:
Gauntlets that rearrange matter itself.
Cursed, inflicts Poison.

607.name: EHI Apocalypse Fists
607.description:
Gauntlets holding the world's oil compressed.
Godlike strength, and cell rot.

608.name: Omniadaptive Combat System
608.description:
A combat system that adapts to any threat
put in front of it.

620.name: Loose-headed Spear
620.description: A spear whose head is bound on loosely.

621.name: Crude Spear
621.description:
A plain spear with a soft iron tip.
Can poison on hit.

622.name: Deadly Plunger
622.description:
A plunger with sharpened metal in the cup.
Can inflict Nausea on hit.

623.name: Sharpened Pool Cue
623.description:
A pool cue sharpened at one end.
Can inflict Nausea on hit.

624.name: Broom Spear
624.description:
A broom handle with a knife taped on.
Can inflict Poison on hit.

625.name: Antenna Rapier
625.description:
A car aerial taped stiff and sharpened.
Can inflict Oily on hit.

626.name: Sign Post
626.description:
A sign post pulled up with its concrete.
Can inflict Nausea on hit.

628.name: Seed Spear
628.description:
A spear grown from a blade seed.
Can poison on hit.

629.name: Short Spear
629.description:
A short spear made for thrusting.
Can poison on hit.

630.name: Sumerian Spear
630.description:
A Sumerian copper spear with a leaf blade.
Can poison on hit.

631.name: Pilum
631.description:
A Roman javelin built to bend on impact.
Can poison on hit.

632.name: Dory Spear
632.description: A bronze-tipped spear of ancient Greece.

633.name: Boarding Pike
633.description: A long pike for holding off boarders.

634.name: Long Spear
634.description:
A spear on the longest haft that will
still be carried.

635.name: Iklwa
635.description:
A Zulu short spear with a long blade,
made for close work.

636.name: Rifle Bayonet
636.description: A bayonet fixed to a rifle for close work.

637.name: Naginata
637.description: A Japanese polearm with a curved blade.

638.name: Halberd
638.description:
A European polearm with an axe blade
and a spike.

639.name: Poleaxe
639.description:
A long polearm with axe blade and spike.
Can poison on hit.

640.name: Glaive
640.description:
A polearm with a curved blade, made
against horsemen.

641.name: Axe-Headed Pike
641.description:
A pike with an axe head at the tip.
Can poison on hit.

642.name: Fire Lance
642.description:
An early Chinese spear with a rocket tube
lashed to it. Strikes with Fire.

644.name: Tempest Trident
644.description:
A trident that calls up a storm.
Strikes with Ice.

645.name: Dragon Spear
645.description:
A spear forged from a dragon's fangs.
Can poison on hit.

646.name: Warding Spear
646.description:
A warded spear that raises a field around
its bearer. Fire.

647.name: Leviathan Fang Spear
647.description:
A spear tipped with a sea serpent's fang.
Strikes with Water.

648.name: Serpent Caller
648.description:
A spear tipped with a Gobekli Tepe carving
that calls serpents. Cursed, can poison.

649.name: EHI Combustion Lance
649.description:
A spear tipped with crystallised oil that
bursts on impact, burning its bearer.

650.name: Gravity Spear
650.description:
A plain-looking Gobekli Tepe spear that
bends gravity. Thunder.

651.name: Varlenia Returning Spear
651.description:
A golden Varlenia spear that comes back
when thrown. Cursed, can poison.

663.name: Foam Projector
663.description:
An experimental gun firing sticky foam
to pin a target. Can poison on hit.

665.name: Microwave Denial Emitter
665.description:
A directed emitter that throws a beam of
microwaves. Can poison on hit.
